parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic and designed to be pressed by hand.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that pushes down to dispense liquid from the container through the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head is the upper section of the dispenser that connects the pressing lid to the outlet spout, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outlet spout for dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but is connected to the moving lid and internal pump mechanism.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the spout or nozzle part of the dispenser, made of plastic, through which the liquid exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of liquid outward when the lid is pressed, ensuring controlled dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed relative to the head and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of plastic, designed to hold liquid soap or lotion.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid to be dispensed and provides structural support for the upper components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the foundation of the dispenser.
